newsitem.title: USA: Vita Foods Products completes IPO.
newsitem.headline: Vita Foods Products completes IPO.

text.p: Vita Food Products Inc said Friday it completed its initial public offer and began trading exclusively on the Chicago Stock Exchange.
The company said it offered 750,000 shares and 750,000 warrants.

Vita Food Products, which has produced herring products for more than 65 years and cured and smoked salmon for 25 years, makes prepared food products. The company sells its products to supermarket chains, wholesale clubs and institutional food service operators.
The company's shares closed Friday unchanged at 5-1/2 on the Chicago Stock Exchange on volume of 86,100 shares.
